heading: Wednesday, September 2, 2026
topLine: 2 model releases: Google Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber and Meta Muse Spark 1.3.

items.headline: Google releases Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
items.summary: Google calls Gemini 3.8 Flash its best reasoning and coding Flash model, with gains over 3.7 Flash on software engineering and agentic tasks, at the same introductory $0.75/$3.75 pricing. Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, for vulnerability detection and patching, is limited to trusted defenders through the Fairwind Program.

items.headline: Meta releases Muse Spark 1.3
items.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 updates Meta's Spark line for agentic and coding work and is available in Muse Code and the Meta Model API, with a max reasoning setting. Meta reports it uses about 20% fewer tool calls and 25% fewer tokens than Muse Spark 1.2 in internal coding comparisons.
